name: @aion/job-posting
description: Deterministic explicit local Job Posting import

scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @aion/career-evidence && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/**/*.test.js" "test/**/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/contracts.test.js"
scripts.test:structured: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/source.test.js" --test-name-pattern=structured
scripts.test:text: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/source.test.js" --test-name-pattern='Markdown|text'
scripts.test:currentness: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/currentness.test.js"
scripts.test:operations: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/operations.test.js"
scripts.test:persistence: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/persistence.test.js"
